```{r readdata, echo = F, include = F}
# load data set
empro <- here::here("data", "EMPRO_data_20260506.RData")
load(empro)

# analysis data set (remove exclusions)
dat <- empro_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(empro_cnstdate) & enrollment_month<=45 & !is.na(cohort_empro))

```

# EORTC Distribution
## Native scale
```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = eortc_6)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#a6dba0", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "EORTC at 6 Months", x = "EORTC Score", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
qqnorm(dat$eortc_6)
qqline(dat$eortc_6, col="red")

shapiro.test(dat$eortc_6)

parameters::skewness(dat$eortc_6)
parameters::kurtosis(dat$eortc_6)

```

## Square root transformation
```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = sqrt(eortc_6))) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#a6dba0", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "EORTC at 6 Months (square root)", x = "EORTC Score (square root)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
qqnorm(sqrt(dat$eortc_6))
qqline(sqrt(dat$eortc_6), col="red")

shapiro.test(sqrt(dat$eortc_6))

parameters::skewness(sqrt(dat$eortc_6))
parameters::kurtosis(sqrt(dat$eortc_6))

```

## Cube root transformation
```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = eortc_6^(1/3))) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#a6dba0", color = "black") +

  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
qqnorm(dat$eortc_6^(1/3))
qqline(dat$eortc_6^(1/3), col="red")

shapiro.test(dat$eortc_6^(1/3))

parameters::skewness(dat$eortc_6^(1/3))
parameters::kurtosis(dat$eortc_6^(1/3))

```


## Log transformation
```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = log(eortc_6))) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#a6dba0", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "EORTC at 6 Months (log)", x = "EORTC Score (log)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),

        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))

```

## Reflected and log-transformed
Reverses the scale
```{r}
dat$logtrans <- log(101 - dat$eortc_6)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = logtrans)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#a6dba0", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "EORTC at 6 Months (reflected log)", x = "EORTC Score (reflected log)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
qqnorm((dat$logtrans))
qqline((dat$logtrans), col="red")

shapiro.test((dat$logtrans))

parameters::skewness((dat$logtrans))
parameters::kurtosis((dat$logtrans))

```

## Inverse Hyperbolic Sine
```{r}
dat$ihs <- log(dat$eortc_6 + sqrt(dat$eortc_6^2 +1))

ggplot(dat, aes(x = ihs)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#a6dba0", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "EORTC at 6 Months (IHS)", x = "EORTC Score (IHS)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
qqnorm((dat$ihs))
qqline((dat$ihs), col="red")

shapiro.test((dat$ihs))

parameters::skewness((dat$ihs))
parameters::kurtosis((dat$ihs))

```

## Square root (100-x)
```{r}

ggplot(dat, aes(x = sqrt100)) +
```
